name: Toda Megumi
source:
She is the captain of the track and field team. She is a very capable girl and excels academically. 

She has a cheerful personality and is a bit strong-willed. She has a high sense of shame and pride.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_210.html#character]official site[/url]]
